spec.query: SELECT last("score") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'score' AND "item_name" = 'overall_srs' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter

spec.description: Overall SRS component score. >=90 OK, 70-89 degraded, <70 critical (mirrors the parser).
spec.title: Overall SRS Score (latest)

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'source' AND "item_name" =~ /^severity_([0-9]+|unknown)_alert_count$/ AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "item_name" fill(none)

spec.description: severity_<n>_alert_count source metrics. Total active alerts saturate at the backend cap (~250).
spec.title: Alert counts by severity

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'source' AND "item_name" =~ /^(unique_alert_title_count|affected_og_count|affected_fh_count|affected_server_count|risk_alert_count)$/ AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "item_name" fill(none)

spec.description: Unique alert titles plus affected OG / FH / server counts.
spec.title: Alert & impact breadth

spec.query: SELECT last("collection_error_count") FROM "SRSReportRun" WHERE "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("analysis_error_count") FROM "SRSReportRun" WHERE "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("duration_seconds") FROM "SRSReportRun" WHERE "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("regions_collected_count") AS "regions" FROM "SRSReportRun" WHERE "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter

spec.description: Tables, metrics, lookback window, and regional coverage of the most recent run.
spec.title: Latest run shape

spec.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'source' AND "item_name" = 'risk_alert_count' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter

spec.description: risk_alert_count source metric — alerts touching position/signal/fill/loss/risk/pnl.
spec.title: Risk / Capital alerts (latest)

spec.query: SELECT last("summary") FROM "SRSReportTable" WHERE "table_name" = 'score' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter

spec.description: summary sentence from the SRS Score table for the most recent run.
spec.title: Latest overall verdict

spec.query: SELECT last("summary") AS "summary", last("row_count") AS "row_count" FROM "SRSReportTable" WHERE "summary" =~ /.+/ AND "table_name" != 'score' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "table_name", "table_type", "status_class"

spec.description: Per-table health, summary sentence, and row count for the most recent run.
spec.title: Latest table health & summaries

spec.query: SELECT last("detail") AS "detail", last("url") AS "url" FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'readiness' AND "detail" =~ /.+/ AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "table_name", "item_name", "status_class", "risk_label"

spec.description: Readiness checks with status, risk, and detail text; sort/filter to focus on current problems.
spec.title: Readiness findings (detail)

spec.description: Backend collection failures in the most recent run.
spec.title: Collection errors (latest run)

spec.description: Failed Bedrock table calls in the most recent run.
spec.title: Analysis (Bedrock) errors (latest run)

spec.query: SELECT last("score") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'score' AND "item_name" = 'overall_srs' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("score") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'score' AND "item_name" <> 'overall_srs' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "item_name" fill(none)

spec.description: Per-component scores (Exchange, Market Data/Feeds, Trading Apps, Infrastructure, Risk/Capital, Jobs/Data, Alerts/Incidents).
spec.title: Component scores over time

spec.query: SELECT last("score") FROM "SRSReportMetric" WHERE "metric_type" = 'score' AND "env" =~ /^$env$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "item_name"
